application.description: Note-taking app used by a care provider's staff, with a pending decision to open it to client families.
application.name: CareNotes

assumptions: The reviewer could not reach the data controller before this revision; the sensitive-data question is open.
context.data_summary: Care notes about identifiable people. Whether they include health details is exactly what nobody has confirmed yet.

authentication.rationale: Signup is disabled in the exported settings; whether invitations are restricted in practice is unconfirmed.

data_sensitivity.rationale: The care notes may contain health information. The data controller has not answered, and guessing the benign answer here would be the whole mistake this model exists to prevent.

financial_operations.rationale: The founder says the app never charges anyone; the repository contains a live payment integration with a configured price. Unresolved.

network_exposure.rationale: The deploy target is a public platform URL with no listing or index, but nobody confirmed whether the address is shared beyond the staff.
